newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ajinomoto recovers slightly after arrests.
newsitem.headline: Ajinomoto recovers slightly after arrests.

text.p: Ajinomoto Co Inc shares opened lower on Wednesday after the firm said on Tuesday that two of its executives had been arrested on suspicion of paying company funds to racketeers, but they soon recovered, brokers said.
The shares opened at 930 yen, down 10 yen from Tuesday's clos. But the shares had risen to 944 yen by 0024 GMT.
"The news of the arrests and the paying of funds to racketeers is encouraging selling, but the event is not expected to harm the firm's earnings," a trader at at second-tier brokerage said.
"Ajinomoto is one of the 225 shares included in the Nikkei average and when basket buying emerges, it gets support," he added.
